alerts.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued August 11 at 6:07AM EDT by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
alerts.desc:
The areas affected include...
Tidal Potomac from Indian Head to Cobb Island MD...
Tidal Potomac from Key Bridge to Indian Head MD...

At 606 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated a front, capable of producing
winds to around 30 knots. This front was located over Reagan National
Airport, moving east at 25 knots.
